channel.title: Kashyap Raiyani — Writing
channel.description: Practical notes on ML, AI and engineering.

item.title: Split by author before measuring text models
item.description: A synthetic companion to a PAN 2018 project shows why post-level and author-level evaluation answer different questions, with measured results and reproducible code.

item.title: From 13 bands to six classes: revisiting Sentinel-2 scene classification
item.description: A walkthrough of my Sentinel-2 research and its public code, separating published benchmark results from the checks needed to reproduce the workflow today.

item.title: Training-serving skew: when the same model sees different numbers
item.description: A reproducible synthetic experiment shows how scaling only at prediction time changes a random forest's behaviour, and how a persisted pipeline keeps the input contract consistent.

item.title: Evaluating AI decisions beyond a single accuracy score
item.description: Separate task correctness, uncertainty and workflow outcomes when deciding whether an AI component is useful.

item.title: Jev and System One: designing a decision layer
item.description: Where a typed decision model fits in an agent harness, and what to measure before giving its answers operational consequences.

item.title: Preventing Data Leakage in Customer-Level ML Datasets
item.description: Customer identity, prediction time and training isolation, explained with a reproducible synthetic experiment and measured results.
